name: web-serif-gallery-hero-with-two-overlapping-painting-cards-on-warm-haze
title: Hero 'A gallery for the work you are proud of.' in serif with two overlapping painting cards on a warm beige haze
whatItIs: A cream page with a soft warm haze band and a left column with a black serif headline, a grey subline, a black Start your gallery pill and a text link See examples, and at the right a tall card of an old seascape painting with a smaller card of a mountain landscape overlapping its lower right corner, both with soft shadows.
whatItMeans: Warm and cultured; painterly images with serif type make a tool feel like a gallery.
techniques: Use serif type and a warm haze.
Pair a black filled button with a text link.

vocabulary.definition: One image card partly covering another.
A soft beige blur behind content.
A headline in an elegant serif.
A plain link beside a primary button.
